as_told.title: JAL 1628 followed by a giant craft over Alaska

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1986, over Alaska, a Japan Airlines pilot flew alongside something unknown for 45 minutes, and that the radar record was taken by the White House but is now public and has been studied by physicists. A researcher, Kevin Knuth, tells it as Japan Airlines flight 1628, a cargo flight flown by Captain Kenju Teruchi, who saw a giant craft, without the 45 minutes or the White House detail. If true, it would be a long sighting by a trained pilot backed up by radar.
